note: Step 0b (docs/internet_research_protocol.md §5a), revision 2026-11-01.4, fixed before any Step-0b call. The lead makes every call, one per assistant message (checked), in this order, whatever the earlier answers; P1b last. Each result is saved at once with tools/save_connector_text.py --raw --plan research/_fragments/alphaxiv_calibration_2026-10-29/manifest_0b.json --label <label> --record research/_fragments/alphaxiv_calibration_2026-10-29/saves_0b.jsonl --source-id <source_id> --name <file name> (a call without a result: --no-result instead of --raw and --name). After P1b, step0b_eval.py pending lists the generic errors; each is retried once, after P1b, one per message, as <label>_r (file raw_<label>_r_<id>.txt); a result that arrives late for a call without a result is saved as <label>_late. Then the audit and evaluate run once (commands below); only that run decides. Arguments are copied from this file exactly: the captions of Q_2203, Q_2201 and Q_2101 are ASCII; Q_DIS keeps the Step-0 'LHμC' with U+03BC GREEK SMALL LETTER MU. The saved files are git-ignored; the record, the audit and the result hold no delivered text except one-line refusals.
